SQL-on-FHIR v2 shared test suite (vendored)
===========================================
tests/*.json + tests.schema.json vendored verbatim from:
  repo:    https://github.com/FHIR/sql-on-fhir.js  (the relocated home of the HL7/sql-on-fhir
           shared test suite — see HL7/sql-on-fhir commit 48f3607 "Remove relocated tooling")
  path:    tests/
  commit:  7969489777b72ea87e866c320c461f7a13df9388
  fetched: 2026-08-23

Format (tests.schema.json): each file = { title, fhirVersion, resources: [FHIR resources],
tests: [{ title, view: ViewDefinition, expect: [rows] | expectError | expectCount }] }.
The harness evaluates each ViewDefinition over the file's resources with the repo's FHIRPath engine
and compares the produced rows (order-insensitive unless the test demands otherwise).
